title: Refactor Camera WebRTC Fallback Chain & Native Camera Capture
description: Refactor WebRTC camera initialization with a progressive 4-level fallback retry chain ({ video: true }, deviceId iteration) and add HTML5 native camera capture support for mobile & desktop.
completionDetails: Refactor inisialisasi WebRTC kamera dengan rantai fallback 4-level ({ video: true }, deviceId iteration) dan menambahkan fitur Kamera Native HTML5 (capture='environment') untuk langsung mememicu kamera aplikasi OS tanpa hambatan izin WebRTC browser.
